scope: SUM159 00d00h00m dead-classification development across 320 fields and two cell-mask branches
provenance_note: Intermediate classifier versions were produced during an iterative uncommitted calibration session. Their frozen outputs are the authoritative record for historical comparison. The final object-aware implementation is reproducible from commit 208128b7 or later.

stages.objective: Baseline classification before dead-signal context protection.
stages.key_parameters: Candidate gate: area 20-2500 px; aspect <=4; mean delta >=0.60; P90 delta >=2; absolute P90 >=15; SNR >=3. A retained assigned Dead object could override the whole Combined cell.
stages.run_method: Read the frozen production classification_fusion and classification_fusion_nucleated_only d0 outputs from full_fusion_shape_strict_20260711_155940.
stages.output_artifacts: Source production classification_fusion branches; summarized in d0_branch_before_after_metrics.csv.
stages.code_provenance: Original production code predating the iterative d0 calibration; represented by frozen outputs.

stages.objective: Protect clearly RGB-live cells from weak or adjacent Dead-channel candidates.
stages.key_parameters: RGB-live compact-cell gate: area <=500 px, Combined coverage >=0.60, P90 delta >=20, SNR >=50. RGB-uncertain gate: coverage >=0.45 and P90 delta >=10. No strong-direct bypass.
stages.run_method: Run the field runner template for all 320 records in both branches, then run the merge template. Local execution used xargs with 8 workers.
stages.code_provenance: Iterative working-tree state; exact source snapshot was not separately committed. Commands and frozen outputs were retained.

stages.objective: Recover F5/H9-like strong death signals rejected by cell-level overlap gating.
stages.key_parameters: Strong-direct bypass: Dead P90 delta >=35 and Dead SNR >=90. Automated strong reference: keep_signal=True, P90 delta >=40, SNR >=100.
stages.run_method: Run the field runner template for all 320 records in both branches, merge summaries, then audit context-aware versus strong-direct outputs.
stages.code_provenance: Iterative working-tree state; exact source snapshot was not separately committed. Commands and frozen outputs were retained.

stages.objective: Retain every upstream Dead mask independently instead of one best object per Combined cell.
stages.key_parameters: Complete 8,289-object ledger; confirmed objects separated from rejected/unassigned candidates; supplemental counting introduced.
stages.run_method: Run both branches over all 320 field records with the field runner template, merge summaries, and run the object-aware audit after each revision.
stages.output_artifacts: object_aware_all_d0, object_aware_all_d0_v2 and paired nucleated-only/audit directories.
stages.code_provenance: Iterative working-tree states; exact v1/v2 source snapshots were not separately committed. Frozen outputs preserve the comparison evidence.

stages.objective: Keep RGB-live cells live while retaining adjacent confirmed Death objects as supplemental events.
stages.key_parameters: RGB-live cells cannot be changed to dead by an adjacent object. RGB-uncertain cells require whole-cell coverage >=0.45 or compact-cell coverage >=0.30 with area <=500 px.
stages.run_method: Run both branches over all 320 field records with xargs -P 8, merge summaries, and run object_aware_automated_reference_audit_v3.
stages.code_provenance: Iterative working-tree state; exact v3 source snapshot was not separately committed. Frozen outputs preserve the development record.

stages.objective: Represent overlapping live-cell and confirmed-death masks without overwriting either biological layer.
stages.key_parameters: Strong direct: P90 delta >=35 and SNR >=90. RGB-live transfer remains disabled. RGB-uncertain same-cell support uses coverage >=0.45, or >=0.30 for area <=500 px. Two or more nuclei support overlapping_live_dead_multi_nucleus; one nucleus supports live_with_death_signal.
stages.run_method: Run both branches over all 320 records, merge summaries, generate cell-state masks, confirmed-death masks, two-channel overlap masks, three QC families, audit, annotations, and detector stress results. HPC uses 25_dead_d0_classification_audit.sh with 16 parallel workers.
stages.output_artifacts: Local object_aware_all_d0_v4 branches; HPC classification_original and classification_nucleated_only plus automated_audit, annotations, and detector_stress.
stages.code_provenance: Final implementation is contained in git commit 208128b7 and later; HPC rerun recorded git SHA 208128b73d9cd22e0a9531ad229bff64792fa1af.

stages.objective: Test whether a segmentation-independent global detector could recover strong objects without increasing live-cell hits.
stages.key_parameters: Strong-reference and synthetic-relocation recovery evaluated independently of production classification; the detector was not connected to production because recovery was incomplete.
stages.output_artifacts: dead_object_detection_stress_v2 locally; detector_stress in the HPC current run.
stages.code_provenance: Final stress-test implementation is contained in commit 208128b7 and later.
